description: This file defines a React functional component named NavBar that renders a navigation bar with routing links, user authentication controls, and role-based admin links. It manages navigation actions such as logout and dynamically displays links based on user role and authentication status.

methods.name: NavBar()
methods.description: React functional component that renders a navigation bar with links based on user authentication and role, and handles logout functionality.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Asynchronous function that calls signOut from auth context, then navigates to the '/login' route, handling errors silently.
